title: v2.8.2 - License Modal Activation & UI Fix
notes:
### Fixed in v2.8.2:
- Fixed a JavaScript error in initStyleControls that prevented initLicenseControls from attaching click events
- Top-right 'Activate License' button now opens the modal reliably
- Modal close button (X), backdrop click, and Escape key now close the modal
- Activation button and Enter key execute the license activation immediately
